query: Which candidate external datasets or clinical sites will be used for transportability tests, how will geographic/temporal/sociodemographic splits be created, and what delta-AUC or calibration-drift thresholds will block deployment?

response.query: Which candidate external datasets or clinical sites will be used for transportability tests, how will geographic/temporal/sociodemographic splits be created, and what delta-AUC or calibration-drift thresholds will block deployment?
response.answer: The candidate external datasets for transportability tests will be selected from diverse clinical sites. Geographic/temporal/sociodemographic splits will be created using stratified sampling. Deployment will be blocked if delta-AUC or calibration-drift exceeds predefined thresholds.
